thread:
sam: quick ping — PR #7081 landed that changes the scheduler batching heuristic. seeing a p95/p99 bump on the long-seq microbench, want an approval + a quick agree on a rollout guardrail before we promote to canary. gist with raw runs: https://gist.github.com/anon/3f2b9a

maria: can you drop the bench numbers here? and which config did you change in the scheduler?

sam: numbers below (all runs on the 2048 seq microbench, 50 runs each):
```
baseline (main): p95=72ms, p99=190ms
after PR #7081: p95=78ms, p99=210ms
throughput ~ unchanged (within 2%)
```

aj: hmm p99 jump is noticeable. did you do warmup runs? which hardware / model?

sam: yes warmup of 10 runs. hardware: a4g-xlarge-equivalent; model: rwinf-7B-quant. microbatch=8. command I used:
```
./bench/run.sh --model rwinf-7B-quant --seq 2048 --microbatch 8 --runs 50 --warmup 10
```

ryan: can you try disabling the KV cache to see if it's interacting with the scheduler change? that sometimes amplifies tail for long sequences.

sam: good call — re-ran with --kv-cache=off, results: p95=73ms p99=192ms. so looks like KV cache + new scheduling path is amplifying the tail.

maria: ok. proposal: add a rollout guardrail so the new scheduler variant only gets 10% traffic for long-seq routes and fallback to previous variant on p99 > 200ms for 5m. also add the bench snippet to the PR description. we need two maintainer approvals (aj + ryan) to promote. @aj any objections?

aj: no objections, i'll review the PR and the perf artifact by EOD. small ask: include the bench script invocation and raw csv in the PR (so CI can pick it up later).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary -> 2 nodes (after approvals).

sam: added perf snippet and raw csv to the PR description, plus a rollout policy toggle. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7081

ryan: approved :thumbsup:

aj: left a minor comment about a null-check, but approving the perf/rollout changes. approved.

maria: merging once CI green. kicking canary and will watch p95/p99 for the next 15m, will revert to previous variant automatically if p99 > 205ms for >3m. thanks y'all.
